# Golden ROP fixture (vendored)

`ppg_000.rop` and `acc_000.rop` here are copied verbatim from the
[ppg-bp](https://github.com/EliasVahlberg/ppg-bp) repo's
`tests/fixtures/golden_session/`, generated by that repo's
`scripts/make_golden_bundle.py`. They exist so
`RopFormatGoldenTest.kt` can assert the Kotlin ROP writer produces
byte-identical output to the canonical Python reference implementation,
without this repo needing a runtime or build-time dependency on `ppg-bp`.

If the ROP wire format changes in `ppg-bp` (record layout, header fields,
or the golden bundle's fixed parameters), regenerate the fixture there
(`python scripts/make_golden_bundle.py`) and re-copy `ppg_000.rop` and
`acc_000.rop` here. `RopFormatGoldenTest.kt`'s constants (session UUID,
epoch offset, sample counts, per-sample values) must mirror
`make_golden_bundle.py`'s constants exactly — if you change one, change
both, or the byte comparison will fail for a reason unrelated to an
actual bug.
